BASS core and official add-ons notice

Notice Summary (not authoritative full license text)
====================================================

This notice covers the native BASS core and official add-ons retained by
BeMusicSeeker. It does not cover BASSASIO or BASS_FX; those components have
separate notices in 01a-BASSASIO-NOTICE.txt and 01b-BASS_FX-NOTICE.txt.

Current classification: GREEN
The current release is non-commercial, non-revenue end-user software. The
upstream BASS terms state that BASS is free for non-commercial use. A future
commercial or monetized release is a trigger for a new license review; it is
not a current YELLOW condition.

Copyright: Un4seen Developments Ltd.
License: Proprietary upstream terms; this repository's MIT license does not
apply to the native binaries.

Current retained x64 components:
- bass.dll 2.4.18.3 / API 0x02041203
- bassmix.dll 2.4.12.0 / API 0x02040C00
- bassenc.dll 2.4.17.0 / API 0x02041100
- basswasapi.dll 2.4.4.1 / API 0x02040401

Authoritative sources:
- https://www.un4seen.com/bass.html
- https://www.un4seen.com/doc/bass/bass.html
- https://www.un4seen.com/bassmix.html
- https://www.un4seen.com/bassenc.html
- https://www.un4seen.com/basswasapi.html

The retained DLL versions and SHA-256 values are recorded in
devdocs/spec/bass-runtime-dependency-set.md. Keep this summary with every
distributed package and use the authoritative upstream pages for the terms.
